response.sql: WITH account_avg AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as account_avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), account_region AS (SELECT aa.account_id, aa.account_avg_amount, d.A3 as region FROM account_avg aa JOIN account a ON aa.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_avg_amount) as region_avg_amount FROM account_region GROUP BY region), all_region_avg AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM region_avg) SELECT ra.region, ra.region_avg_amount as figure, ra.region_avg_amount - ara.overall_avg as exceeds, ra.region_avg_amount / ara.overall_avg as ratio FROM region_avg ra CROSS JOIN all_region_avg ara WHERE ra.region_avg_amount > ara.overall_avg ORDER BY ra.region
